```plato
//==
// # Planar
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - Rectangles, oriented boxes, and regular polygons
//  - Circles and circle-derived planar regions
//  - Ellipses and superellipses
//  - Planar triangles and quadrilaterals

//==
// # Rectangles, oriented boxes, and regular polygons
//
// The remaining parametric planar regions: an axis-aligned rectangle with uniformly
// rounded corners, a rectangle with arbitrary rotation, and the regular n-gon
// inscribed in a circle. Sizes are FULL extents, so every body halves them; winding
// convention: counter-clockwise is positive.

// An axis-aligned rectangle with corners rounded by a uniform CornerRadius.
// CornerRadius is clamped to half the smaller side; zero gives the exact
// rectangle, the maximum gives a stadium or circle.
type RoundedRect2D
    implements IGeometry2D, IClosedShape, IConvexShape, IConnected, IArea, IBounded2D, ICentroid2D, IContainsPoint2D
{
    Rect: Rect2D;
    CornerRadius: Number;
}
```
